name: terylon-pane
description: Terylon Cockpit: the Terylon band, status line and pane in Claude Desktop, a mod opened by /terylon-cockpit: what waits for you above the prompt, the health of Terylon and today's cost in the status line, and one pane with Waiting, Goals, Notices, Memory and Health tabs, every subject by its ref and every figure in Terylon's words. It answers the leader's questions, adds tasks and goals, and takes the owner's acts on their cards; it never merges. Requires terylon-os.
